title: Existing application human-facing audit
description: Populated project using the same persisted project model and 30-stage workflow as ordinary projects. Sources and finished product are actual files in this repository.

userEnteredData.requestedOutput: Audit the existing application as a human-facing closed-loop reliability product.
constraints: Test project is a project, not the app
Prompts, outputs, evidence and history remain inspectable

objective.exactUserObjective: Audit the existing Closed-Loop Reliability application as a real project and produce a human-readable audit artifact verifying the one-app constraint, compact human-facing project UI, inspectable project work/history, 30-stage preservation, contextual appendix behavior, and a genuine populated test project.

requirements.requirement: One application entry point; the test project is data inside that application.
requirements.failureCondition: A second or parallel app exists.

requirements.requirement: The normal project interface is compact and human-facing rather than a developer or agent console.
requirements.failureCondition: Primary UI is dominated by oversized controls or implementation bookkeeping.

requirements.requirement: The populated project exposes user data, sources, requirements, generated prompts/instructions, outputs, runs, evidence, defects, corrections, release data and complete history.
requirements.failureCondition: Substantive work is hidden behind summaries.

requirements.requirement: Stages 01 through 30 remain available as workflow semantics and stage-specific records/actions.
Appendices A-F operate contextually as fresh-context, blocker, change/invalidation, release, new-project and output-receipt capabilities.
requirements.failureCondition: Appendix semantics are deleted or rendered only as permanent checklist walls.

tests.procedure: Inspect repository entry points and project-loading state.
tests.expectedResult: One application; test project uses ordinary project state.

tests.procedure: Inspect control dimensions, hierarchy and project navigation.
tests.expectedResult: Compact mobile controls and human project hierarchy.

tests.procedure: Open the populated project and inspect each substantive work category.
tests.expectedResult: All required project information is visible on demand.

tests.procedure: Count and inspect stage records and navigation.
Inspect fresh-run, blocker, change, release, new-project and output-receipt behavior.

mutations.violationMode: Hide project history and show only a completion badge.
Render all controls as large full-width buttons.
Render Appendix A-F as permanent checklist pages.

productionInstruction.objective: Inspect the existing application and produce the audit artifact from observed application evidence.
procedure: Inspect the existing application entry point and runtime components.
Inspect the project UI and populated test project including complete retained history.
productionInstruction.completionCriteria: All five mandatory requirements are SATISFIED with evidence and finished artifact identity is verified.

generatedPrompts.title: Production instruction
generatedPrompts.prompt: Using only authorized application sources and controlling requirements, inspect the existing application. Verify REQ-001 through REQ-005 and produce the audit. Record UNKNOWN when evidence is unavailable.

generatedPrompts.title: Independent execution
generatedPrompts.prompt: In a fresh context, inspect the frozen candidate and produce the audit independently. Do not inspect another run or reviewer feedback. Preserve the output separately.

generatedPrompts.title: Independent verification
generatedPrompts.prompt: Verify the assigned run against every active requirement. Return SATISFIED, VIOLATED, or UNDETERMINED with evidence. The generator is not its sole verifier.

generatedPrompts.title: Adversarial review
generatedPrompts.prompt: Attempt to disprove the finished audit. Search for hidden project work, missing stages, oversized or machine-facing UI, deleted appendix semantics, false test-project claims, stale evidence and unsupported release conclusions.

output.summary: Initial audit omitted complete project-history inspection.
Corrected audit includes complete project-history inspection.

generatedOutputs.output: Ten separately retained initial audit outputs; each omitted complete project-history inspection.
REQ-003 = VIOLATED in all ten runs; DEFECT-001 opened.
Ten corrected independent audits; REQ-001 through REQ-005 = SATISFIED.
Ten unchanged confirmation executions; all mandatory determinations remained SATISFIED.

defects.observedFailure: Initial instruction did not explicitly require complete retained project-history inspection.
defects.correctionRequired: Add complete-history inspection and rerun the full ten-execution iteration.
